description: Interactive map with tile, UDF and SQL layers.

centerLng.description: Map centre longitude. Setting centerLng or centerLat turns auto-fit off unless autoFit is set explicitly.

centerLat.description: Map centre latitude. Setting centerLng or centerLat turns auto-fit off unless autoFit is set explicitly.

autoFit.description: Fly to the loaded data once on first load: inline GeoJSON plus every visible udf / sql row layer. Defaults to true, or false when centerLng/centerLat is set (an explicit camera wins). Later pans, re-runs and basemap switches leave the camera alone, and a camera the viewer left behind wins. Tile layers never report bounds. When off the map opens at centerLng/centerLat/zoom.

type.description: Layer type. All types render through deck.gl: mvt/raster from tileUrl, geojson from inline data, sql or udf rows, h3/heatmap/arc/scatterplot/deck-geojson for deck-specific styling.

tileUrl.description: Tile URL template with {x}/{y}/{z} placeholders (mvt, raster, tiled h3)

minZoom.description: Minimum zoom for tiled layers (mvt, raster, tiled h3)

maxZoom.description: Maximum zoom for tiled layers (mvt, raster, tiled h3)

zoomOffset.description: Zoom offset for tiled layers (useful for hex tile generalization)

maxRequests.description: Maximum parallel tile requests for tiled layers

sourceLayer.description: Source layer name for MVT tiles (defaults to 'default')

udf.description: UDF placeholder, e.g. {{my_udf}} or {{my_udf?param=value}}. The UDF is run directly (no share token needed) and re-run when it changes: the whole result as rows for geojson/deck layers, or per tile when tile is true. Combine with sql to query the result. Mutually exclusive with tileUrl.

tile.description: With udf: run the UDF per XYZ tile (raster → PNG bitmaps, h3 → hexagons, other types → vector features). Tiles render through deck.gl.

sql.description: DuckDB SQL query with {{udf_name}} placeholders. Rows are converted to GeoJSON for rendering.

filters.description: Feature filters applied on the client: range filters on numeric properties, category filters on any property.

geometryColumn.description: Column containing the geometry: GeoJSON strings (use ST_AsGeoJSON in SQL), GeoJSON objects, or WKB blobs as stored by GeoDataFrame outputs. Defaults to 'geometry'.

h3Column.description: Column containing H3 hex indexes (for h3 layer type).

latColumn.description: Column for latitude (point data). Defaults to 'lat'.

lngColumn.description: Column for longitude (point data). Defaults to 'lng'.

tooltip.description: Show tooltip on hover. true = all properties, string[] = specific properties.

legend.description: Show color legend for this layer. true = auto title, {title} = custom title. Only applies when fillColor or lineColor is data-driven.

fillColor.description: Fill color: [r,g,b], CSS string, or data-driven {type:"continuous"|"categorical", attr, ...}

lineColor.description: Stroke color: [r,g,b], CSS string, or data-driven {type:"continuous"|"categorical", attr, ...}

coverage.description: H3 hex coverage 0-1 (1 = no gap, 0.8 = small gaps)

elevationAttr.description: Feature property to use for extrusion height

showLegend.description: Show color legend for layers with data-driven colors

showLayerPanel.description: Show layer controls panel for toggling visibility and opacity

showSidebar.description: Show the sidebar toggle for editing layer style, filters and SQL at runtime. Edits are runtime overrides; use the sidebar's copy action to bake them into this config.

param.description: Canvas parameter name to sync viewport bounds [west, south, east, north]

autoSendDebounceMs.description: Debounce ms for auto-send (0 = send on every move)

clickParam.description: Canvas parameter that receives the properties of the last clicked feature

stateParam.description: Canvas parameter that mirrors the map's runtime state (camera, layer type, style, filters, SQL overrides) so other widgets can read it. It is saved with the canvas and restored on reload. Use the sidebar's save action to write layer edits into this config permanently.

style.description: Inline CSS styles as a plain CSS string
